title: faa-aircraft-registry-mcp-server: lookup registration

description: Search FAA aircraft types by manufacturer/model name, aircraft type code, or category code to discover 6–7-character manufacturer/model/series codes and browse specifications. Pass a code to faa_get_aircraft_type for specs or faa_search_registrations as manufacturerModelCode for exact registration matches, then faa_lookup_registration for details. At least one filter is required. Every response reports totalCount (all matches, not just this page); when more remain, it returns nextOffset — pass it back as offset to page forward.

title: faa-aircraft-registry-mcp-server: search aircraft types

description: Search active US civil aircraft registrations by owner name, make/model, exact manufacturerModelCode, serial number, state, aircraft type, or Mode S (hex) code. Discover codes with faa_search_aircraft_types and get full records with faa_lookup_registration. Filters are AND-combined and at least one is required. Owner-name search is available on deployments that expose owner PII. Responses report totalCount across all pages and return nextOffset when more matches remain.

aircraftType.description: FAA aircraft type code: 1–9, H (Hybrid Lift), O (Other), exact match. Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset.

limit.description: Requested page size (positive integer, default 25); requests above 200 are clamped.

manufacturerModelCode.description: Exact FAA manufacturer/model/series code: 6–7 alphanumeric characters, trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset. Discover codes with faa_search_aircraft_types. AND-combined with other filters.

modeSCode.description: Six hexadecimal characters for the Mode S code (ICAO 24-bit address), exact match. Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return — pass the nextOffset from a previous response, with identical filters, to page forward (default 0).

ownerName.description: Registrant name to match (full-text). Rejected when owner-PII redaction is on.

serialNumber.description: Exact manufacturer serial number, trimmed and matched case-insensitively. Leading zeros, punctuation, and internal spaces are significant. Blank is unset. Use manufacturerModelCode or makeModel to narrow duplicate serials.

state.description: Two ASCII letters for a state, territory or military postal code (e.g. WA, GU, AE, AP; exact match). Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset.
